<function name="Set3DEnabled" parent="IGModAudioChannel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the 3D mode of the channel. This will affect <page>IGModAudioChannel:Get3DEnabled</page> but not <page>IGModAudioChannel:Is3D</page>.

This feature **requires** the channel to be initially created in 3D mode, i.e. <page>IGModAudioChannel:Is3D</page> should return true or this function will do nothing.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2020.04.29</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="enable" type="boolean">true to enable, false to disable 3D.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
